title: Compilation manifest
description: Data-artifact shape for a collection resource's compilation manifest. Declared enforcing on the user's context at install time; the manifest is the build authority for compilation - members by ref plus order, with pandoc metadata passed through.

collection.description: Full ref of the owning collection resource

title.description: Compiled work title; defaults to the collection title

output.description: Output file base name; defaults to the collection slug

ref.description: Full resource ref of the member document

order.description: Position in the compiled work; ties broken by list position

title.description: Override title for this member in the compiled work

metadata.description: Pandoc metadata passed through to the epub build (author, language, rights, ...)
